name: Baltimore City (Maryland State Board of Elections)

feed.identity_note: Answered our named User-Agent on Nov 3, 10:21 to 10:25 PM CT (src-east builder): 200s from Cloudflare, no challenge. The old host elections.maryland.gov now answers 302 to results.elections.maryland.gov.
feed.election_id_from: Each page's own heading, "Unofficial 2026 Gubernatorial General Election Results for ...". The pages carry no date; election_dates pairs the board's name with Nov 3, 2026 (the SBE's 2026 Election Calendar, research/raw/results-MD/elections-maryland-gov-elections-2026-2026-election-calendar-pdf-ad7db3--20261103-1251.pdf).
feed.pages_note: Baltimore City's county page (printer twin) holds every contest on a city ballot, its local Questions A to I included.
